## Introduction
Saint Irybelda stormed into the Succubus Castle alone.  
With her proficient Holy Magic, she easily annihilated the monsters and finally reached the throne room of the Succubus.  
Having easily dispersed the last monsters guarding the Succubus, Irybelda, feeling certain of her victory, showed a momentary lapse in her guard due to her carelessness...

## 简介
圣女Irybelda 独自一人攻入淫魔城。  
她熟练使用神圣魔法轻松地消灭了魔物们，最终抵达淫魔的宝座间。  
Irybelda 轻松踢散了保护淫魔的最后一批魔物，她相信胜利已经在握，但就在那一瞬间，她因为疏忽露出了一点点空隙...
